paragraphs: Swamiji often turned to the life of Jesus. He recalled the rich young man who came to Jesus asking what he must do to gain eternal life.

Jesus told him he lacked just one thing: he should sell everything he owned, give it to the poor, and he would have treasure in heaven; then he should take up his cross and follow. Hearing this, the young man's face fell. He had great wealth, and he walked away sorrowful.

We are all a bit like him, Swamiji said. That call keeps sounding in our ears, day and night. Surrounded by pleasures and worldly business, we think we have forgotten it. Then comes a quiet moment, and we hear it again: give up everything and follow Me.

Jesus also taught that whoever tries to hold on to his life will lose it, and whoever gives it up for God's sake will find it. Swamiji explained that the one who lets go of this small life for the Lord gains the life that never dies.
learn: We all have things we cling to: comfort, money, image, plans. Every so often a quieter voice asks us to loosen our grip for something higher. Listening to it, even a little, is how real freedom begins.
